title: Cartography Helper
description: Utility asset pack for filling out maps in Better than Adventure!
body:
This asset pack for the Beta 1.7.3 fork, [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/), helps the task of mapping by changing the background color of maps to a more visible magenta and decreasing the size of map icon for better visibility of map pixels near the player.

#### No more wondering whether that's desert or unmapped!

![Demonstration of smaller map icons increasing map visibility.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/806d48f687cc5865ea2f6fe1025a5410327fd1c1.png)

# Installation
This asset pack is made for [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/) as mentioned above and is unlikely to work at all on plain **Beta 1.7.3!**

Download this asset pack and put it in the `texturepacks` folder found within your Better than Adventure instance. The ingame Texture Packs option has a button to open this folder if you don't know where to find it.
